## Checklist

- [ ] **The link works** — public, resolves, not a 404 or an empty repo
- [ ] **It has substance** — a real `SKILL.md` / `plugin.json` / provider implementation, plus a README
- [ ] **Not already listed** — I searched the README for the repo name
- [ ] **Correct section** — and placed alphabetically inside it
- [ ] **Format matches** — `- [name](repo-url) by [author](author-url) — one-line description. **[tag]**`
